title: A Simple Harmattan Dust Routine for Busy Homes
excerpt: Fine dust on every surface? A 15-minute daily routine that keeps it under control.
body:
Harmattan season brings a fine layer of dust that settles on everything. The trick is little and often, rather than one big clean at the weekend.

## Start high, finish low

Dust falls, so clean shelves and window ledges first, then tables, then the floor.

## Damp, not dry

A dry cloth just moves dust around. Use a microfibre cloth lightly sprayed with Multi-Surface Cleaner to trap it.

- Close louvres during the windiest hours
- Wipe window sills daily
- Mop floors every other day
- Shake out doormats outside
